commands: git status --porcelain; echo "---RUNENV---"; echo "GITHUB_RUN_ID=${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-}"; echo "GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT=${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-}"; echo "GITHUB_ACTIONS=${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}"

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled 2>/dev/null
git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before && [ -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before ] && [ ! -L .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before ] && git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
